caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile design with a decorative floral pattern primarily rendered in a deep blue color on an off-white or cream background. The composition features a central symmetrical motif formed by clusters of stylized flowers and leaves radiating outward, surrounded by an intricate border of similar botanical elements. The drawing includes a detailed representation of fringes along the top and bottom edges in alternating blue and off-white colors. The left and right sides are bordered with solid blue bands. In the upper-right corner, a small portion of the textile is illustrated as turned down, revealing the reverse side with a continuation of the floral pattern in blue, but with the positioning and overlap of the motif indicating it is the underside. The overall arrangement includes repeated, interconnected vines, leafy branches, and ornate flowers, all densely packed and distributed to create a balanced, ornamental effect.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
